Solid orange background is our exact brand canvas. Hero = laurel + '#1' badge + stars, headline, then a big angled iPhone showing the LOCKED state. Screen 3 floats a white card with the blocked app icons over the phone. Direct template for our 'Lock screen' and 'Apps unlocked' beats.

Dark starry bg, tilted phone with lifestyle plate (person exercising behind the phone), 'Instagram is Blocked' lock screen, before/after screen-time bar chart (6h32 → 1h49), '22 years of your life' scare stat. Steal: before/after analytics layout and lock-screen composition.

Illustrated hills bg, brain mascot. Screen 4 'Cut your screen time in half!' = red bars 'Before' → green bars 'After' inside one phone. Screen 3 = app-icon grid + coin chips. Steal: the before/after bars for 'Screen time down'.

Black pill tag above headline (RECLAIM / BETTER / NEVER), tilted phones on soft gradient, TikTok lifestyle plate with overlay notification 'You're at 1 hour of screen time'. Orange flame-sprinkled 'Set goals and build streaks!' screen. Steal: pill + headline hierarchy, streak card.
Icons flying out of the phone
Purple gradient. Hero: '3 hours' highlighted in a pill, star rating, review quotes, and social app icons bursting out of the phone bottom. Steal: icon-burst composition for the 'unlocked' moment.

Full-bleed photo (woman in bed, phone glow) with 'Sleepless / Distracted / Stressed' chips = PROBLEM frame. Screen 2: tilted phone with app icons exploding outward. Steal: problem-frame photography and icon explosion.

White bg, dark-blue type, laurel '15 MILLION SUCCESS STORIES', press logos row, app-icon cloud. 'No bypass.' word in a pill. Insights screen with weekly usage bars. Steal: press/laurel stack, single-word pill emphasis, insights chart.
Black + neon, phone + watch props, map
Black bg, neon green, italic uppercase headlines, two tilted phones, Garmin + watch props, map territory. Perfect reference for 'Location at the gym' beat (map + phone + watch) in our orange.

Pastel bg, brain mascot, app icons popping out beside the phone on screen 2, two overlapping phones on screen 3, big '60%' with 'Rot time / Pickups' stat tiles. Steal: overlapped phones and stat tiles.

Blue→green gradient, tiny black tag above headline (THRIVE EVERYDAY), 'Reclaim 2h+' hero with review cards + laurels, lock screen 'Instagram is blocked by Jomo', emoji mood row. Steal: tag hierarchy and review-card hero.

Illustrated green hills, 'Get back 1h36 every day' with 'Screen Time 1h15m ↓50%' stat card and hourglass mascot, hand-drawn arrow 'No ignore button'. Steal: annotated callouts, ↓% stat chip for 'Screen time down'.
Dark navy, press logos (WaPo, Product Hunt, YC), lock screen with pushup icon 'do 10 push ups to unlock it', floating review bubbles. Steal: lock screen with exercise glyph + short instruction line.

Photographic hand holding phone, floating notification cards ('Doomscrolling Alert!'), Apple Design Award badge, big '29:59' timer. Premium, editorial. Steal: photo-real hand/phone for the 'You are walking' beat.

Dark teal, big two-line headline, one phone: today ring '5,276', bar-chart 'Set your daily goal', '7 days in a row' flame. Direct reference for the 'Steps up' analytics beat.
